content: Yesu ꞌamasega ꞌitoholo hila
Sabati mulina gona ꞌiꞌadaleya wiki hauhauna ꞌana sabwelo nugenugetana ꞌoina, Meli Magidala maꞌina waliyesa sinaoma galiha sabi boꞌene.
Ma mwaniꞌiniꞌi madouna ꞌipiliya, beno Bada ꞌina anelose ꞌaigeda galewega ꞌisuluma, ta dimwa galiha ꞌahwanega ꞌibuiwasiyeya, ma ꞌoina ꞌimiyatoiya.
Aneloseina ꞌana ꞌita gide namala, ma ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo waꞌewaꞌeꞌena moisa.
Ma galiha ꞌana toꞌitayahinao anelose siꞌiteya ma simatauta madouna, ꞌoinega sitaiya ma sibeꞌuwa baleꞌuwa toꞌamasa gide.
Ma aneloseina wahiwahineyedi ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwaeya, “Sahena waꞌateꞌateyoho. Yasanasanapu ꞌomi Yesu tauna siloheꞌamasiya wabesebese.
Tauna geya ꞌebwa, weyahina ꞌamasega ꞌitoholo pwaiya, gide mwalo ꞌihegwaegomiya. Wanaoma ma ꞌina ꞌebeꞌeno waꞌita gaugaulinamo,
ma muliyetega watauya mwayamwayau ma ꞌana tomuliyao wahegwaedi ꞌabehega Yesu ꞌamasega ꞌitoholo pwaiya, ma nata ꞌinugeta Galili ꞌoina, ma ꞌomi wamuliye, nage ꞌoina waꞌita. Beno tuwa.”
Coinega wahiwahineyedi maꞌidi matauta, ma wete maꞌidi yaliyaya, galiha siꞌebesineya ma sipili mwayamwayauwa, ꞌabehega Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoidiya ginaula bewa sida hepwaile.
Ma Yesu ꞌedai ꞌilobediya ma ꞌiloyauwedowediya, ma sinaoma ma ꞌahena sigitohodiya ma siꞌetuluha ꞌoina.
Coinega Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Sahena waꞌateꞌateyoho, ma hesi watauya ma ꞌiyagwao wahemataluwedi ma sitauya Galili ꞌoina, nage ꞌoina ꞌabwa siꞌitegau.”
Toꞌitayahinao ꞌidi hepwaila
Wahiwahineyedi ꞌabwa ꞌedai sitautauya, ma galihina ꞌana toꞌitayahinao tupwadi sitauya ꞌasa Yelusalema ꞌoina, ma toꞌaha silatuwa gide sihepwaileya topwaoli madoudi ꞌoidiya.
Coinega topwaoliyedi ma babada mahetediyao siꞌetoꞌautama ma siloina, ta mane toꞌitayahinaowedi siꞌebwaediya
ma ꞌane tomota ꞌoidiya sida hepwaila dadane, ma ꞌane sida gwae, “Nihuwana ꞌaꞌenoꞌeno ma Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao sitauyama ta wahina siyagahiya.”
Eeta sihegwaediya, sigwae, “Ceguma toloina madouna wasa bewa ꞌihesagohe, nata ꞌaꞌabowe ma ꞌoinega geya sawasawahina ma ꞌigamwasowala ꞌoimiya.”
Coinega ꞌidi mane siꞌeweya, ma topwaoliyedi ma babadao ꞌidi nuwatuhuina sihematamataneya, ma ꞌidi hepwailaina ꞌilelewana meYudiya ꞌoidiya, ꞌoinega bewa tuwa gide wete sihehegwaegwae.
Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌidi paihowa ꞌiꞌebwaediya
Coinega Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao site lebeni sitauya Galili, ma sihaneya ꞌoyaina Yesu ꞌihepwaileya ꞌoina,
ma Yesu siꞌiteya ma ꞌoina siꞌetuluha. Ma tupwadi ꞌoidiyega ꞌabwa maꞌidi henuwanaluwa.
Eeta Yesu ꞌinaoma ꞌoidiya ma ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Tamagu loina waiwaina mabwaiyana galewa ma baleꞌuwa ꞌiꞌebwae pwaigauwa.
Coinega watauya ma ꞌasa mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiya waloguguya, ma ꞌoinega tomota sihemisaegau, ma wete waꞌabihe babitaisodi Tamagu saninega ma Natuna Taugu saniguwega ma wete Yaluyaluwa Tabuna saninega.
Loina mabwaiyana yaꞌebwaegomiya ma waheꞌitaedi, ma taudi wete sida muliyedi. Ma moisa, taugu baꞌidamiu tamiyamiya sauga mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya, sauga bewa ma ꞌana siga baleꞌu ꞌana ꞌebelosaloha ꞌoina.”
